name: wall_weathering
description: Wall texturing/weathering (墙壁肌理): emits one facade rectangle that is never a flat single-material slab. Five parameterized build-circle techniques: (1) 材质掺比 — palette of [block, weight] entries, a primary + 2-3 accents blended by seeded weighted random (e.g. stone_bricks 60 + cracked 15 + mossy 15 + cobble 10); (2) 深浅分层 — base_height bottom rows use the heavier/darker base_palette, gradient=true ramps the accent share up toward the ground (weathering creeps from the base); (3) 壁柱/线脚分格 — pilaster_every N full-height pilaster columns + course_rows horizontal beam rows (log axis derived from wall direction); (4) 藤蔓做旧 — vine_pct chance per column of a vine strip hanging down the front face; (5) 修补痕迹 — patch_pct > 0 swaps 1-2 small rectangles wholesale to patch_material (empty = auto 预设基座主材, 同风格族异材; default 0 = off, 老调用输出逐字节不变). Five presets with ratios derived from GrabCraft sample stats + community gradient recipes (see wall_weathering.md); explicit palette/base_palette override presets. Deterministic via seed.
when_to_use: Any exterior wall larger than ~3x3 — a flat one-material wall is exactly the '墙壁没有肌理' failure this card fixes. Use for house/keep/tower facades, retaining walls, ruins. origin = bottom-LEFT cell of the facade (seen from outside), y = base layer (ground contact); facing = the outward normal. Rule of thumb: primary >= 55%, each accent 5-25%, accents must share the primary's color family (mossy/cracked variants of the primary are the safest). Windows/doors are NOT this card's job — cut them with window_trim/arch_window after, or leave their cells out of the rectangle.
use_for: 外墙肌理/做旧:石构(stone_brick_aged/deepslate_dark)、田园(cobble_rustic)、红砖(brick_townhouse)、木骨架白墙(plaster_timber 配 pilaster_every);废墟/古建拉高 vine_pct + cracked/mossy 权重

origin.notes: 立面外视左下角格;y=基座层(贴地)

facing.notes: 立面外法线;藤蔓面状态/梁轴由此推导

preset.notes: 配比预设(见 presets 节);显式 palette 覆盖

palette.notes: 主体掺比;首项=主材(建议>=55),其余=辅材;权重大小即占比

base_height.notes: 底部基座带层数(用 base_palette,更深更重)

base_palette.notes: 基座带掺比;典型:圆石+苔石为主

gradient.notes: true=辅材占比向基座递增(风化从地面爬上来);false=全高均匀

pilaster_every.notes: 0=关;N=每 N 格一根通高壁柱(u=0 恒有);木骨架风配 3-4

pilaster_material.notes: 壁柱;原木=木骨架,stone_bricks=古典壁柱

course_rows.notes: 线脚/横梁所在 y 偏移列表(整行替换);*_log 梁轴自动沿墙推导

vine_pct.notes: 每列出现垂藤条的概率(%);废墟 25-40,民居 5-15,现代 0

patch_pct.notes: 修补面积占比(%);0=关(向后兼容);1-2 个小矩形整区换异材,典型 5-15

patch_material.notes: 修补异材(如 oak_planks 补砖墙);空=预设基座主材(同族)

seed.notes: 随机种子;同参同输出,换种子换肌理分布

stone_brick_aged.mix: stone_bricks 60 + cracked 15 + mossy 15 + cobble 10;基座 cobble 40/mossy_cobble 30/stone 20/stone_bricks 10
stone_brick_aged.use_for: 城堡/塔楼/石砌民居(GrabCraft stone/military 样本主材)

cobble_rustic.mix: cobblestone 55 + mossy_cobble 20 + stone 15 + andesite 10;基座加 gravel
cobble_rustic.use_for: 中世纪农舍/田园(GrabCraft medieval 样本 cobblestone 8.1% 为主材之一)

deepslate_dark.mix: deepslate_bricks 55 + cracked 20 + cobbled_deepslate 15 + deepslate_tiles 10;基座 cobbled_deepslate/deepslate/blackstone

brick_townhouse.mix: bricks 75 + stone_bricks 15 + mud_bricks 10;基座 stone_bricks 为主

plaster_timber.use_for: 木骨架(半木构)白墙,必须配 pilaster_every 3-4 + course_rows

pitfalls: 单色满铺是大忌(本卡存在的原因);但辅材也别超过 3 种、占比别超 45%——那是杂色不是肌理
辅材必须与主材同色系/同质感族(mossy/cracked 变体最安全);cobblestone 墙掺 oak_planks 这种跨族混搭几乎必翻车
基座带要更深更重(cobble/mossy/deepslate),上浅下深;反过来(顶重脚轻)视觉要塌
vine_pct 别超 40;藤蔓只出现在立面外侧,别在室内墙用;现代风 vine_pct=0
pilaster_every 开了就要让壁柱通高落地(本卡保证);间距 2 以内就成栅栏了,木骨架推荐 3-4
course_rows 会整行替换(含基座行);把 0 放进 course_rows 等于放弃 base_palette 的基座带
掺比是加权的随机分布,不是周期图案——别手动摆成棋盘格/条纹;同参数同 seed 输出恒定,要换分布改 seed
门窗洞口不在本卡范围:先发墙再用 window_trim/arch_window 卡切,或干脆把洞口列排除在矩形外
example: python patterns/wall_weathering.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"facing":"south","width":9,"height":6,"preset":"stone_brick_aged"}' --out wall1.json && python patterns/wall_weathering.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,120],"facing":"east","width":11,"height":7,"preset":"plaster_timber","pilaster_every":3,"course_rows":[0,3],"vine_pct":0}' --out wall2.json
